tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[soul of a paraboloid of revolution]

Source: petersen:page-0476 ↗ def:pet-ch12-totally-convex 1. ch12:12.4.4Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth rotationally symmetric metric $dr^2+\rho ^2(r)d\theta ^2$ on $\mathbb {R}^2$ with $\rho '<0$ (a paraboloid of revolution). Every geodesic from the origin $r=0$ is a ray to infinity, so the origin is a totally convex soul; most other points admit geodesic loops. \end{example}
